questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

The important ______ is where to arrange the funds from.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'issue'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given fill in blank is** 'issue'. **
 
• Let's look at the meaning and examples of the given options: 
 
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Solution**
 the answer to a problem
 *There's no easy **solution **to this problem.*
 
 

 **Result**
 something that happens or exists because of something else
 *The road has been widened, but the **result **is just more traffic.*
 
 

 **View**
 an opinion, belief, or idea, or a way of thinking about something
 *In my **view**, her criticisms were completely justified.*
 
 

 **Issue**
 a subject or problem that people are thinking and talking about
 *As employers, we need to be seen to be addressing these **issues **sympathetically.*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence arrangement of funds is the **'issue'. **
 
• Therefore, by reading the above explanation we find that the correct answer is **Option 4. **

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *The important **issue** is where to arrange the funds from. *

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is the ____________ to reach Delhi.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fastest"** means moving or capable of moving at high speed. (सबसे तेज)

 
 
• **Example: **He took the** fastest** train to reach the city.
 
 
 
• **"Route" **refers to a way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination. (मार्ग)
 
 
• **Example: **The **route** to the village is scenic and beautiful.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase **"fastest route"** implies the quickest way to reach a destination.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: It is the **fastest route **to reach Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quickest route** (सबसे तेज मार्ग): This phrase is synonymous with "fastest route" and could also be a correct answer.

 
 
• **Example:** He always searches for the quickest route to avoid traffic.
 
 
 
• **Lowest route** (सबसे निचला मार्ग): Indicates the route with the lowest elevation, which is not relevant in this context.
 
 
• **Example:** The lowest route through the mountains is often the safest during winter.
 
 
 
• **Strongest route** (सबसे मजबूत मार्ग): This phrase does not make sense in this context as routes are not described in terms of strength.
 
 
• **Example:** This sentence does not logically fit the context.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate connotation to fill in the blank.

Raju is such a ______ always prying into other people's business!
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**nosy**" is appropriate because it means** inquisitive in an intrusive or prying manner,** which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence describes Raju as someone who pries into other people's business, thus "**nosy**" has the **correct connotation.**
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4** do not appropriately convey the sense of prying.

Therefore, the correct sentece is: ***"Raju is such a nosy__ always prying into other people's business!"***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "cheeky"** is** incorrect **because it means impudently bold or disrespectful, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "perky"** is** incorrect;** it means cheerful and lively, which is not relevant here.
 
• **Option 4: "stingy"** is** incorrect** as it implies unwillingness to spend money, which is unrelated to the context of being intrusive.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Doctors and nurses who are treating COVID-19 patients are finding it difficult ______ long working hours.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'To cope with'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Carry on-** continue an activity or task. (एक गतिविधि या कार्य जारी रखें।)
 
• **Service for-** the action of helping or doing work for someone. (किसी की मदद करने या काम करने की क्रिया।)
 
• **Cope with- **(of a person) deal effectively with something difficult. ((किसी व्यक्ति का) किसी कठिन कार्य से प्रभावी ढंग से निपटना।)
 
• **Manage with-** To be able to operate, function, or carry on adequately with a smaller amount of people or things than one had anticipated. (एक से कम लोगों या चीजों के साथ पर्याप्त रूप से संचालित करने, कार्य करने या पर्याप्त रूप से चलाने में सक्षम होने के लिए।)
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the phrases, the correct answer is Option 3 i.e. to cope with.

**So the correct sentence is-** *Doctors and nurses who are treating COVID-19 patients are finding it difficult **to cope with** long working hours.*

questions.question:

The boxer was knocked out cold by a powerful________ punch to the jaw.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The term "**right punch**" is commonly used in boxing to describe a punch thrown with the right hand.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The boxer was knocked out cold by a powerful **right punch** to the jaw."*

• **Rite** – A religious or other solemn ceremony or act.
 
• **Wright** – A maker or builder, such as a playwright or shipwright.
 
• **Right** – Correct or appropriate, or a direction (opposite of left). In this context, it refers to the direction/side.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to complete the given sentence.

With the increasing market prices and stagnant salaries, he is _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"feeling the pinch"** means experiencing financial difficulties due to increased expenses or reduced income. (आर्थिक तंगी महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example: **With the rise in rent and utility bills, many families are** feeling the pinch.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***'feeling the pinch'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beating the rap** (कानूनी सजा से बचना): Escaping punishment or avoiding consequences.

 
 
• **Example:** The celebrity was accused of tax evasion but managed to **beat the rap **due to lack of evidence.
 
 
 
• **Taking a break** (ब्रेक लेना): Pausing or resting from an activity.
 
 
• **Example:** After hours of studying, she decided on** taking a break** to relax.
 
 
 
• **Getting it off his chest** (मन की बात कह देना): Talking about something that has been bothering you.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt much better after **getting it off his chest **and sharing his worries with a friend.

• It's **typically used to** describe a spontaneous or uncontrollable expression of joy or amusement.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* At that time, I only knew that I adored the way he laughed for no **reason**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The perfume she uses has a strong _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scent" **refers to a distinctive smell, which fits the context of the sentence describing perfume.
 
• The other options do not fit the context:** "cent"** refers to currency, "send" is a verb meaning to dispatch, and **"sent"** is the past tense of send.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The perfume she uses has a strong** scent**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cent:** A unit of currency equal to one hundredth of a dollar.
 
• **Send:** To cause something to go or be taken to a particular destination.
 
• **Sent:** The past tense of send.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

You don’t usually discuss money with friends, because it may ______ the relationship negatively.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e., 'affect'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a **verb **to show the negative reaction process on a relationship because of a certain condition. 
 
• The correct **verb **for the given blank is **affect.**
 
• **Affect,** when used as a verb, means** to act on or change someone or something.**
 
• Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effect **is generally used a noun and means **a change that results when something is done or happens.** (We use affect as a verb (an action word) and effect as a noun (an object word).)
 
• **Strengthen **is a **verb **which means to make or become stronger.
 
• **Improve **is a **verb **which means to make or become better.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I should have stopped them then and there. But it never even _______ to me that I should.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e., 'occurred'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank should have a word in the **past tense form** that defines the thought process of the subject (I).
 
• The best fit word for the given blank is **occurred **which is the past tense form of the verb **occur.**
 
• **Occur means (of a thought or idea) come into the mind of.**
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The meaning of the other given options and their usage are as follows - 

 
• **Suggested **is the past tense form of **suggest **which means to put forward for consideration. 

 
 
• I **suggested **the following tweaks to the action plan.
 
 
 
• **Happened **is the past tense form of **happen **which means to take place.
 
 
• The incident **happened **years ago.
 
 
 
• **Reminded **is the past tense form of **remind **which means to cause (someone) to remember someone or something.
 
 
• She was **reminded **about her obligations as a queen.

questions.question:
Select the correct collocation to complete the following sentence.

He made __________ use of the opportunity to travel.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation of the word "use" with its English and Hindi meanings:**

 
 
• **Use:** The act of putting something into action or service. (इस्तेमाल)
 
• **Example:** He made good **use** of his free time by learning a new skill.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of the word "full" with its English and Hindi meanings:**
 
 
• **Full:** Entire or complete in extent or degree. (पूर्ण)
 
• **Example:** She made** full** use of the resources available to her.
 
 
 
• In context, **"full use"** means **to make the most comprehensive or effective use of something.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **full**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entire **(सम्पूर्ण): Referring to the whole of something without exception or reservation.

 
 
• **Example:** He ate the entire pizza by himself.
 
 
 
• **Whole **(सम्पूर्ण): Also means complete, but often refers to something undivided or unbroken.
 
 
• **Example:** She spent the whole day at the beach.
 
 
 
• **Total** (कुल): Refers to the sum or entire amount of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The total cost of the project was very high.
